scriptData.label: Start of Turn: Arrhythmia

description.label: Description
description.value:
A powerful blow to the chest bruises your breastbone and makes your heart start beating irregularly.

Effects: Roll an Extended Challenging (+0) Endurance Test at the start of each of your subsequent turns. Failure means you gain @Condition[Unconscious]. An Astounding Failure (-6 SL) means you die. Accumulating 4 SL means your heart starts beating normally again.
